title: Missing debug adapter for VS Code extension on Windows

raw.title: Missing debug adapter for VS Code extension on Windows
raw.body: ### Description There doesn't seem to be any included debug adapter when trying the VS Code extension on a Windows machine. I would have expected one. I'd rather not depend on an Cargo installation, unless absolutely necessary. I would also be happy if it was included as a release asset, just like the CLI is included as exe. ### Command ```bash . ``` ### Output ```json ``` ### Minimal Arazzo spec ```yaml ``` ### Environment Windows 11
